IncidentDef.label: Fleshbeast Horde
IncidentDef.letterText: The ground seems to be giving way. The sounds of writhing flesh and cracking bones can be heard from below.\n\nReadings indicate significant activity, be ready, a horde is coming!
IncidentDef.letterTextPlural: Several sinkholes have started appearing. The sounds of writhing flesh and cracking bones can be heard from below.\n\nReadings indicate significant activity, be ready, a horde is coming!
